decisions.reason: The plug-in line builds on the established offer and has its own website page, so results appear to meet aspirations, and the firm's slack in a growing industry supports keeping it.
The building digital twin service is only mentioned and its results are uncertain, but it fits the firm's strategic direction and the firm has the slack to carry it while it matures.
The authentication delegation service overlaps with the identity service, which makes consolidation possible, but it sits close to the core offer and is cheap to keep in a growing market.
The open GIS framework is central to the firm's strategy of combining open, extensible components, so it is likely to meet aspirations and be retained.
The identity service was actively promoted at launch and integrates with the firm's GeoIT applications, so it is likely to be judged satisfactory and kept.
